project_summary: Grocery delivery platform with slot-based routing optimization and cold-chain last mile

components.name: Catalog and pricing service
components.description: Perishable SKU management, dynamic pricing by zone, and substitution rules at pick time.

components.name: Delivery slot and routing optimizer
components.description: VRP solver integration for driver routes, slot capacity, and real-time ETA updates to customers.

components.name: Warehouse pick-and-pack app
components.description: Tablet UI for pickers with batch picking, temperature zone labels, and weight verification.

components.name: Cold-chain compliance tracker
components.description: Temperature logger integration in delivery bags with breach alerts and customer proof of delivery.
